edits.new: An intention to use something as a kind does not establish the other features required to be that kind, or that the use occurred. A kind may be defined by its intended use; when it also requires other features, state and preserve them. A role, use or component relationship must preserve every required feature of the kind involved.
edits.old: A role, use or component relationship must apply to that kind with its required features; the relationship alone does not establish membership.
